tests.fullTitle: Init TV Show via TVDB Behind HTTP Proxy.Scenario: TV show folder initialized via TVDB behind HTTP proxy
tests.parent: Init TV Show via TVDB Behind HTTP Proxy
tests.body:
async function(){if(env.slowdown){this.timeout(60*1e3)}await browser.pause(5e3);const{folder1}=await import("test/actions/import-folders").then(s=>{const e="default";return s[e]&&typeof s[e]=="object"&&"__esModule"in s[e]?s[e]:s});await when("Import media folder",{...folder1,folderName:`${folder1.mediaName} {tvdbid=355969}`});if(env.slowdown){await delay(5*1e3)}const expectedTitle="WATATEN!: an Angel Flew Down to Me";const folder=getStepContext()._folder;await then(`Sidebar shows folder with title "${expectedTitle}"`);await then("TV show panel shows the expected title and episode table",async()=>{await TvShowPanel.waitForTitleToBe(expectedTitle);expect(await TvShowPanel.toString()).toBe(`Season 0
S00E01 - - - -
S00E02 - - - -
Season 1
S01E01 S01E01.mkv V V V
S01E02 S01E02.mkv V V V
S01E03 S01E03.mkv V V V
S01E04 - - - -
S01E05 - - - -
S01E06 - - - -
S01E07 - - - -
S01E08 - - - -
S01E09 - - - -
S01E10 - - - -
S01E11 - - - -
S01E12 - - - -`)});await then("metadata is persisted with TVDB tvshow id 355969",async()=>{await expectMediaMetadataViaBrowser(folder.path,m=>{const mm=m;expect(mm.tvShow).toBeDefined();expect(mm.tvShow?.id).toBe("355969");expect(mm.tvShow?.database).toBe("TVDB");expect(mm.tvShow?.name).toBe(expectedTitle);expect(mm.tvShow?.airDate).toBe("2019-01-08");return true})});if(env.slowdown){await delay(10*1e3)}}
